**Goal:** a live, submitted project and a pitch that works on someone who has never seen it.
**Depends on:** #
**Feature freeze at:** [from `plans/00-general.md`]. After freeze, fixes only.

## Checklist

- [ ] `/audit` in a fresh session, top fixes done
- [ ] `/persona` architect, ux and each sponsor
- [ ] `/polish`, sized by the rubric's design weight
- [ ] `/pitch` written to `docs/pitch.md`, outsider test passed
- [ ] Timed dry run of the pitch against the live URL
- [ ] Backup video recorded right after the dry run

## Must-haves

- [ ] Live URL works on a phone
- [ ] Backup video recorded twice (60-90s happy path)
- [ ] README has the identity, live link and demo steps, and makes sense without the demo
- [ ] Repo public with no secrets (gitleaks clean)
- [ ] `scripts/evidence.sh` run on main; every sponsor's proof metric from `docs/evidence.md` is in the submission
- [ ] Every submission field filled
- [ ] Submitted 30+ minutes before the deadline
- [ ] Screenshot of each demo step, as a fallback
- [ ] In person: hotspot and display adapter checked
- [ ] Online: the video is the first cut, so record the full pitch, not just the demo
